integrity: Original full-text and equivariance sources inspected for scope, numerical assertions independently rerun as supplements to an analytic proof. Novelty remains contingent on a wider priority review; no external mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The fixed-sample correction does not supply moving-sample-size null quantiles or test power. Uniform first-order collapse assumes gamma/n^2 tends to infinity; fixed-weight consistency remains untouched. The second-order formula requires a finite fitted Weibull MLE and a fixed positive sample.
title: Large-weight collapse and maximum-order reversal of the Weibull min-characteristic goodness-of-fit statistic
